# Interferon response partial fabrication variant A

Analysis of ISG activation showed coordinated antiviral upregulation. IFI6 was upregulated (Table 1). ISG15 was downregulated (Table 1). MX1 was upregulated (Table 1). OAS1 was upregulated (Table 1). IFI44 was upregulated (Table 1). STAT1 was upregulated (Table 1).

Proinflammatory markers: TNF was downregulated (Table 1). IL6 was upregulated (Table 1).
